contracts: Rust owns preferred-height clipping and width reservation for wrapping content, plus viewport geometry, offset, reveal and clamp. Native adapters provide content/text measurements and platform scrollbar/events/AX/windows.
Workspace and import retain their original 0..10000 bounded-height policy and height-for-width sizing; no browser-store, preview admission, persistence or profile policy changes.

Viewport refresh updates scene clipping without rebuilding form state or replacing editor drafts. New shared cases cover both panels: offscreen/reveal, actual successful compositor presentation, narrow/wide wrapping, resize/shrink clamp, wheel/AX range and retained workspace draft.
No dependency added. Full UI tests only after a larger block.
limits: Targeted tests do not establish complete functional/manual/release parity.
Other scroll surfaces, native View/node identity, frames, layout and platform input adapters remain to migrate.
IME candidate windows, VoiceOver, RTL/scale/theme/trackpad/GPU recovery require final manual acceptance.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation or memory improvement established.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped-dependency/license notices are outside this frozen lab acceptance.

initial_probe.note: Metal passed 2 cases; Views failed 2 because the fixture did not show the main window before OpenWorkspaceSettings, which intentionally returns if the main widget is hidden. The corrected fixture explicitly shows the synthetic main widget and still requires successful compositor presentation. Production behavior was unchanged for this correction.

second_probe.note: Showing the synthetic main window resolved presentation timeout. The final fixture also waits for native scrolling and presentation. Later diagnostics established an additional minimum-window-size problem with the fixed spacer; see fixture_correction.

fixture_correction: Native import diagnostics showed widget/viewport/content all 440x1402 with preferred 344x1402: the fixed 900px fixture inflated the native window minimum, removing overflow. The final responsive fixture returns zero spacer height for the zero-width minimum-size query, but 900px at real layout widths. Main-window visibility and asynchronous presentation/reveal waits remain explicit. These fixture corrections did not change production code.

before_explicit_paint.note: Focus passed 2/2; affected Metal passed 27, Views passed 19 with 1 successful-presentation wait timeout in the new workspace case. Final fixture explicitly schedules root paint before requesting successful compositor presentation, matching the second new case and existing Cocoa tests. Production sources unchanged for this fixture correction.
